title: Built with Claude
intro: The projects show what I've built. This is how I build.
summary: I direct AI the way a staff engineer directs a team. I frame the real problem, set the architecture, and make the trade-offs, then put the agent to work exploring the code, building, testing and shipping. The judgment stays mine; the speed comes from the machine. I've turned my process into reusable skills, so every project ships on the same baseline by default: strong SEO, Cloudflare security, and numbers I can stand behind. It's a way of working I've built on Anthropic's own agentic-engineering practices, and it's why I can take an idea to a live, real-world product faster than a traditional build ever allowed.
